newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine union leader suffers mild heart trouble.
newsitem.headline: Argentine union leader suffers mild heart trouble.

text.p: Argentina's top union leader Rodolfo Daer was taken to hospital Wednesday after suffering mild heart trouble before a meeting with other labor officials.

Local television showed the 44-year old leader of Argentina's main labor federation CGT clutching his head and sitting down. He was taken to a Buenos Aires clinic where doctors described his problem as a "slight cardiac indisposition with no repercussions on his general health."
"He had a coronary problem," fellow union official Armando Cavallieri told reporters.

Daer, who became CGT head in late 1996, will remain under observation for 24 hours. A member of the governing Peronist Party, who like other top CGT leaders was long close to President Carlos Menem, he nonetheless led two general strikes in September and December.
